title: A/R Collection: the group row stays pinned under the headings
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Your role has the "View and Manage AP/AR Data" switch on.
  • On today's date the report has two customers next to each other in name order, {Customer-A} then {Customer-B}, each with more overdue invoices than fit on the screen and with a phone number and a credit term on its customer card.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-10 Long List A and {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-10 Long List B, each with 25 overdue invoices.
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu, with the groups of {Customer-A} and {Customer-B} expanded.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Scroll down slowly into {Customer-A}'s rows.
  2. Look at the pinned row.
  3. Keep scrolling until {Customer-B}'s row reaches the top.
  4. Keep scrolling into {Customer-B}'s rows.
  5. Scroll back up slowly until you are inside {Customer-A}'s rows again.
  6. Scroll down fast through {Customer-A}'s and {Customer-B}'s rows.
  7. Scroll fast back up through {Customer-B}'s and {Customer-A}'s rows.
  8. Make the browser window 1200 px wide.
  9. Scroll the table sideways to the right.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Customer-A}'s row stays pinned just under the column headings while its rows scroll beneath it.
  • Step 2: it shows the customer group's chevron (pointing down) and its label: {Customer-A}'s name and count, then "Phone: " and the phone number and "Credit term: " and the credit term; it shows no amounts (the customer group's sums stay in its own subtotal row).
  • Step 3: {Customer-B}'s row pushes {Customer-A}'s row up and off and takes its place; only one group row is pinned at a time.
  • Step 4: {Customer-B}'s row stays pinned.
  • Step 5: the change reverses: {Customer-A}'s row comes back down into the pinned place.
  • Step 6: at speed too, each pinned row is pushed up and replaced cleanly: it never covers the column headings or the Totals row at the bottom, and two group rows never overlap.
  • Step 7: the same going back up: each pinned row is replaced cleanly, never covers the column headings or the Totals row, and two group rows never overlap.
  • Step 8: the table now scrolls sideways (narrower than 1440 px).
  • Step 9: each group row's label ({Customer-A}'s label) stays visible at the left while the columns move.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows), story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout), story SV-11539 (Story 9, A/R Collection call list)

  • S4-R6: “While the user scrolls through an expanded group, that group's row (the bucket label, customer or vendor) stays pinned just under the column headings. Only one group row is held at a time: when the next group's row reaches it, the next row pushes it up and off and takes its place. Scrolling back reverses this.”
  • S4-R7: “When the table scrolls sideways, each group row's label stays visible at the left.”
  • S8-R3: “The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is pinned to the right edge and bold on the header, every row, every expanded row and the Totals row, as on Sales By Customer. At 1440 pixels wide every column of all six reports is visible without scrolling sideways: the customer or vendor name and Transaction type wrap long values onto a second line, Location wraps only on A/P Detail (nine columns), column headings never wrap, and money, date and number columns never wrap. Narrower than 1440 pixels, the table scrolls sideways under the pinned column.”
  • S9-R1: “On A/R Collection, each customer's group row shows, after the customer's name, "Phone: " and the customer's phone number as the customer card shows it.”
  • S9-R2: “For users with the 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' switch, the group row also shows "Credit term: " and the customer's credit term as the customer card shows it ("COD" when none is set).”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §3 D21: “Pinned group row = scroll-driven overlay (ReportPinnedGroupRow + useReportPinnedGroup) showing the group row's chevron and full label — on A/R Collection including "Phone:" and "Credit term:" (S9-R1/R2) — but no money cells (the group's subtotals stay in its own row)”
  • Tech plan §7 Manual testing checklist: “3. Fling-scroll a long expanded group: pinned row pushes up without overlapping header or totals.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

  • "Customer picked: the group row shows "Phone:" and, for users with View and Manage AP/AR Data, "Credit term:". The Totals row follows the customer filter. S9-R1, S9-R2, S5-R18. Exports carry the same lines and columns: S9-R3, S3-R5, S3-R8a." (caption of "Call list on A/R Collection")
  • "While scrolling a group, its row stays under the column headings; the next group's row pushes it up and off. S4-R6." (caption of "The customer row stays pinned")
  • "The headline column (Open Balance; Total on the Summaries) is bold and pinned right; the group label stays at the left. S8-R3, S8-R4, S4-R7." (caption of "Open Balance pinned, light")
  • "Collection and Unpaid Invoices have a customer or vendor picker, and their Totals row ignores it. No phone or credit term on the customer rows." (caption of "A/R Collection: date and customer only")
